inputs.original_text:
Look at this blatant display of corporate entitlement. The owner of Blue Waters has the absolute audacity to complain that the Government collects taxes from them “without doing or investing in anything,” completely ignoring their own massive footprint on our communities and environment. This is just another example of private capital extracting wealth from our society while shirking basic social responsibility. 

And let's talk about the real cost of their operations: plastic bottles can be found everywhere, blocking rivers and drains, which then enter our ecosystems and disproportionately harm vulnerable, working-class communities who bear the brunt of environmental degradation. Instead of taking accountability for the ecological crisis caused by their packaging, this capitalist elite whines about contributing back to the public infrastructure they rely on. We need systemic reform, environmental accountability, and strict regulations to hold these polluters and profit-seekers fully accountable to the people.

This private capital is extracting wealth from our society while shirking basic social responsibility. 

The real cost of their operations is clear: plastic bottles can be found everywhere, blocking rivers and drains, entering our ecosystems and disproportionately harming vulnerable, working-class communities who bear the brunt of environmental degradation. Instead of taking accountability for the ecological crisis caused by their packaging, this capitalist elite whines about contributing back to the public infrastructure they rely on. We need systemic reform, environmental accountability, and strict regulations to hold these polluters and profit-seekers fully accountable to the people.
